name: SS Dang'an
source:
What is the truth behind the unexplained supernatural phenomena we see...;
If it can be explained by science,
then...
What lies behind science?...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2442670/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我们所看到的无法解释的超自然现象背后的真相是什么……；
如果可以用科学来解释的话
然后…
科学的背后是什么？…

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2442670/]Steam[/url]]
